datasets.title: ETOPO 2022 surface elevation, 10 arc-minute subset of the 60 arc-second grid
datasets.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

z.description: surface elevation relative to EGM2008, positive up; ice-sheet tops over Greenland and Antarctica

datasets.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work, NOAA NCEI)
datasets.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information.
datasets.notes: OPeNDAP subset: every 10th sample of the 60 arc-second surface grid (1080 x 2160, float32, DAP2 binary). Land is z > 0 m, ocean z <= 0 m; depth = -z. If NCEI's server ever returns different bytes the checksum check fails; a new registry version is then needed (data unchanged). Alternative: the full 60 arc-second netCDF (about 478 MB), checksum not pinned.

datasets.title: NOAA ERSST v5 monthly long-term mean sea surface temperature, 1991-2020
datasets.publisher: NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory (data: NOAA NCEI)

sst.description: sea surface temperature, annual mean of the 12 monthly long-term means

datasets.license: Public domain (NOAA); the file's license attribute reads 'No constraints on data access or use'
datasets.acknowledgement: NOAA ERSST V5 data provided by the NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA, from their website at https://psl.noaa.gov
datasets.citation: Huang, B., P. W. Thorne, V. F. Banzon, T. Boyer, G. Chepurin, J. H. Lawrimore, M. J. Menne, T. M. Smith, R. S. Vose, and H.-M. Zhang, 2017: Extended Reconstructed Sea Surface Temperature, Version 5 (ERSSTv5): Upgrades, Validations, and Intercomparisons. J. Climate, 30, 8179-8205.
datasets.notes: netCDF-3 classic, sst(12, 89, 180), missing over land and sea ice (-9.96921e36). The file was last modified 2021-02-09. Its global 'climatology' attribute names 1971-2000, but the file name, the PSL listing and climatology_bounds give the 1991-2020 normal. Dataset DOI: 10.7289/V5T72FNM.
